module: ImGui terrain material layer selector (dropdown) for editor tools. Layers are 0-based, like the paint index; -1 means "auto", resolved via util.findMaterialIdx. A button resets to the default value.
notes: The function changes nothing: it returns the newly chosen value, and it is up to the caller to store it.

draw.desc: Draws a selector row (reset button, then dropdown). Returns the new value if the user changed the selection or reset the default, otherwise nil.

cur.desc: Current value (layer index, -1 = auto); converted by tonumber, otherwise opts.default.

opts.desc: id (required, imgui id), label, default (default value), allowAuto (offers the Auto entry), autoNames (names to look up for auto), tooltip.

returns.desc: New chosen index, or nil if nothing changed.
